description: This file defines a PHP trait 'ResourceTypeAndIdTrait' within the AWS SDK that provides methods for extracting resource type and resource ID from a data array, particularly parsing resource strings.

classes.name: ResourceTypeAndIdTrait
classes.description: A PHP trait providing methods to retrieve resource type and ID from data array, and to parse resource strings into its components.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the resource type from the data array.

methods.name: getResourceId
methods.description: Returns the resource ID from the data array.

methods.name: parseResourceTypeAndId
methods.description: Static method that parses a resource string into resource type and resource ID, splitting on '/' or ':'.
